limitations: Public announcements may omit influences on internal deliberations.

our_interpretation: It refers to AI 2027 in the surrounding paragraph.
The ordinary reading is a causal shift in policy priorities toward near-term competitive measures at the expense of longer-term safety and alignment research.
The relevant period runs from AI 2027's publication to Marcus's post.
China inevitably catching up is a subsidiary forecast without a deadline or specified dimension of parity. It cannot be treated as an established premise.
criteria.support_condition: Policy deliberations or causal research show that AI 2027 changed priorities toward export controls or comparable short-term measures and displaced attention or resources that would otherwise have gone to longer-term safety research.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence shows that AI 2027 instead shifted priorities toward longer-term safety research relative to short-term competitive measures. Mere coexistence of both kinds of policy does not establish either direction.
